The container image opens `.dlc` files itself.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The container image opens `.dlc` files itself.** The 1.8.3 image was built with a key it could not use and handed every DLC to the JDownloader backend. The desktop apps were not affected.
- **A release build stops when the DLC key or IV is not 16 characters long,** instead of shipping without them.
